name: Congradient Shading
definition: A shading technique that defines the surface orientation of a voxel as one of a finite set of local gradients, enabling a fast table-driven mechanism. It combines advantages of gradient shading and contextual shading.
summary: Congradient shading is a real-time volumetric technique that accelerates rendering by using concatenated color and gradient data as direct indices to a precomputed illumination look-up table, avoiding per-voxel normal calculations.
